propositions: Reconcile planning mixes snapshot reads, binding decisions, and global caps without pure plan values, causing retry and filter logic to recompute against different observations.
Current preview exposes mutations but not lifecycle effects that a live pass would attempt, and no immutable observation per pass exists.
Pure planner must consume local snapshot, remote snapshot, binding read, mode, selection/filter, and caps before any lifecycle or remote effect, with zero I/O.
Lifecycle intent changes (bind, confirm, re-key, retire, baseline, comment) must be represented as versioned intents during planning and not executed.
Inter-ticket dependencies (create-before-link, parent-before-child) must be encoded explicitly; blocked prerequisites yield deferred disposition rather than out-of-order mutations.
Shadow mode plan must preserve existing mutation array/hash format while adding versioned lifecycle-intent section, and comparisons must match legacy behavior or name approved deltas.
